These are coding environments for reinforcement learning, grouped into 4 catalogs.
Each task puts the agent in a real open-source codebase or program, gives it a written request of the kind an engineer would receive, and grades the result with hidden tests.
Gemini 4 Argon passes 23% of its runs on these tasks and Gemini 3.8 Flash passes 2%.
Every pass rate and plot on these pages covers Gemini models only: Gemini 4 Argon (`google/gemini-4-argon`) and Gemini 3.8 Flash (`google/gemini-3.8-flash`).
